pair_matching: for each source m=min(6, number of frozen verified on-policy correction pairs); collect the first m verified off-policy correction pairs in frozen off-policy example order and chosen-branch action order; require both arms to have exactly m pairs
pair_ordering: preserve verifier-emitted frozen state order and chosen-branch action order exactly; no post-hoc deduplication or reordering
source_truth: same exact frozen base initial state for BASE/OFFPOLICY/ONPOLICY; generateGoldPath=false; max 50 steps; primary outcomes final_score and success>=100
family_advantage_definition: For each task family, compute the median across pair-matched units of (ONPOLICY final_score - OFFPOLICY final_score); the family has ON-policy advantage iff this median is strictly greater than zero.
